mapper.select: SELECT * FROM serial_number WHERE serial_no = #{serialNo} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT * FROM serial_number WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND sn_status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'IN_USE') AND warranty_end_date IS NOT NULL AND warranty_end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND (CURRENT_DATE + #{warningDays}) ORDER BY warranty_end_date ASC
SELECT * FROM serial_number WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND sn_status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'IN_USE') AND warranty_end_date IS NOT NULL AND warranty_end_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY warranty_end_date ASC
SELECT sn.* FROM serial_number sn LEFT JOIN serial_flow_record sfr ON sfr.serial_id = sn.id WHERE sn.serial_no = #{serialNo} AND sn.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sfr.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM serial_number WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM serial_number WHERE sn_status = #{status} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
